upload.title: Upload a cover
upload.hint: Click or drag an image in here

cropper.title: Crop the cover
cropper.hint: Drag to move it, slider to zoom.

preview.emptyHint: Set a title and a tracklist, then the preview shows up here.

settings.coverShapeHint: Album covers are square, film posters stand upright. Switching lets you crop the same picture again.
settings.contentHint: Search an album and every field is filled in. Or just type it yourself.
settings.contentReleaseDateHint: Optional. The year alone, a year and month, or a full date, so 2007, 2007-10 or 2007-10-10. The poster prints it as precisely as you state it.
settings.showSubtitle: Show the artist name under the title
settings.releaseDateLabelHint: What the release date is called on the poster. Leave it empty for Released.
settings.lengthLabelHint: What the length is called on the poster. Leave it empty for Album Length.
settings.tracklistHint: The length is optional. Drag a row by its handle to move it.
settings.titleAlignHint: Applies to the title, the artist and the color palette.
settings.spotifyHint: Where the Spotify code on the poster points. An album, song, artist, playlist or podcast, copied out of Spotify. Without a valid link, no code ends up on the poster.
settings.spotifyNote: Creating the code has your browser query Spotify directly, which passes the link and your IP address to Spotify. More on that under <privacy>privacy</privacy>.
settings.spotifyClear: Clear it, no code on the poster
settings.spotifyInvalid: That is not a Spotify link. Expected is open.spotify.com/album/… or spotify:album:…
settings.qrClear: Clear it, no QR code on the poster
settings.qrHint: Where the QR code on the poster points. The album link by default, clearing the field removes the QR code.
settings.qrHintNoSource: Where the QR code on the poster points. Without a link, no QR code ends up on the poster.
settings.resolutionFixed: This format has a fixed pixel size. The DPI choice only applies to paper formats.
settings.rightsNotice: Only use your own images or private copies. By downloading you confirm that you hold the rights to the uploaded cover, or that you use the poster strictly in private and for yourself. Without those rights, selling it and passing it on are not allowed. Details in the <terms>terms of use</terms>.
settings.exportLarge: This export contains a very large number of pixels and may take a little longer.
settings.exportSoftware: Your browser is using the compatible software renderer. This export may take a very long time.
settings.exportSaveFailed: Saving failed. You can try again.
settings.exportFailed: Could not create the {{format}}. Please try again.

advanced.description: The style stops deciding, you pick the sizes, fonts, and colors.
advanced.risk: Anything goes here. If something slips off the poster, you can still download it.

pipette.hint: Click anywhere on the poster to take the color from there. Esc cancels.

cast.label: Cast
cast.hint: The role is optional and sits to the right of the name. Drag a row by its handle to move it.
cast.showDetails: Show roles next to the names

awards.label: Awards
awards.hint: Prizes the film won, the year on the right. A film search fills in the best-known ones.

chapters.label: Chapters
chapters.hint: The table of contents, numbered like a tracklist. Optionally the page each chapter starts on, on the right.

characters.label: Characters
characters.hint: Who appears in the book, best known first. Optionally who they are, on the right.

works.label: More works
works.hint: Other books by the same author, the year each came out on the right.

listing.formatHint_freeform: What it is about, in a few sentences.
listing.formatHint_cast: The cast, their roles on the right.
listing.formatHint_chapters: The table of contents, numbered like a tracklist.
listing.formatHint_works: What else the author has written.

source.show: Name the text's source on the poster
source.label: Source credit
source.hint: A summary from Wikipedia is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. If you publish, give away or sell the poster, this credit has to be on it. For a poster just for yourself it is optional. If you write the text yourself, leave the field empty.
source.placeholder: e.g. Wikipedia, “The Hobbit”, shortened · CC BY-SA 4.0

infos.label: More info
infos.hint_music: Every line goes into the poster's info column, such as label, producer or studio. Delete whatever you don't need.
infos.hint_film: A film search suggests screenplay, music, cinematography, genre, rating, source material, filming locations and more. Tap a suggestion to put it on the poster. Deleted lines return to the suggestions.
infos.hint_book: A book search suggests series, genre, form, publisher, setting, era and original language. Tap a suggestion to put it on the poster. Deleted lines return to the suggestions.

styles.bloom: Blurred cover as the background, with a gradient
styles.classic: Cream passe-partout, black frame, color bar
styles.onyx: Gallery type on an almost black ground
styles.paper: Gallery type on white, no frame
styles.sand: Gallery type on a beige ground, no frame
